suggestions.rationale: Identified as top priority by Potuz in ACDC #191. Ecosystem (validators, hardware wallets, staking pools) needs public commitment to begin migration planning. LeanVM audit timeline (Feb 1) adds urgency.

suggestions.topic: consensus-specs PR#5770 decision: execution payload gossip validation
suggestions.rationale: Deferred in ACDC #191 pending Monday ACDT discussion and Sepolia/EIP-8037/8038 resolution. Competing alternative (cayman's payload-root-in-bid PR) also in play. Cross-layer alignment needed.

suggestions.topic: FOCIL scope and PQ compatibility for Hegota
suggestions.rationale: Status contested in ACDC #191. CL complexity manageable but PQ interaction and DC compatibility unclear. Decision deferred to future call; sequencing affects Hegota timeline.

suggestions.rationale: ACDC #191 explored PQ Gasper as faster path but feasibility uncertain (aggregation, bandwidth, non-finality handling all require investigation). BLS-DC declared dead; DC work must be PQ-DC. Core architectural decision needed.
